title: Wren and the Will
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Emrys Lockridge, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
